messages:
maria: Deploybot just flagged a promo for deploy-scheduler -> staging as FAILED: artifact fetch 412 Precondition Failed from artifact-proxy in eu-west. Blocking promotion.

deploybot: [automated] promotion blocked: deploy-scheduler v2026.03.21+86 failed artifact pull: HTTP 412. Logs:
```
GET /artifacts/deploy-scheduler/v2026.03.21+86/manifest
-> 412 Precondition Failed (ETag mismatch)
x-cache: HIT from proxy-a
x-cache-bio: miss from proxy-b
```

jonathan: any idea what changed in artifact-proxy headers? we didn't touch scheduler builds

maria: artifact-proxy started sending weak ETags for multipart uploads yesterday during the rolling deploy to eu-west, likely mismatched with S3 object's ETag comparison.

will: can we promote a pinned sha instead of the tag? `sha256:abc123def456...` would bypass manifest ETag check in deploybot

sara: +1, manual promote to sha is safest short-term. will manual promote, but need a rollback plan if canary fails.

jonathan: also we can temporarily disable strict ETag validation in deploybot with env var DEPLOYBOT_STRICT_ETAG=false for this window

infra-bot: NOTE: changing DEPLOYBOT_STRICT_ETAG requires a redeploy of deploybot and will affect all regions. Recommend manual pin+promote.

maria: decision: hold global promote. will do manual pinned promote to staging only, no canary. open PR to add header-normalization fix to artifact-proxy.

will: running manual promote now:
```
deploybot promote --service deploy-scheduler --to staging --image sha256:abc123def456 --skip-canary
```

deploybot: Starting manual promote (triggered by will). Verifying artifact via direct GCS object lookup... OK.

sara: after manual promote to staging, let's run smoke e2e (10m). If green, we can plan a controlled canary with 1% traffic.

jonathan: created issue ENGINFRA-2345 for artifact-proxy ETag normalization + test coverage.

maria: ETA for fix? we need region-wide parity. infra says 4h for hotfix, but we might need a hot restart.

will: taking release window off the main pipeline until fix is in. tagging this promo as blocked for GA.

sara: adding release note entry: "Hotfix: artifact-proxy ETag mismatch hotfix pending. Manual pin used for staging promote."

maria: thanks all. ping @oncall-eng if anything flakes during staging smoke.

deploybot: Manual promote completed to staging at 4319876621. Promotion to prod remains blocked.
